ruleDefinitions.name: EXASOC : Zoho Meeting Client
ruleDefinitions.description: Zoho Meeting Client is often used by Small Businesses. In addition to meetings, this software allows file transfers and remote control of desktop.

sequences.name: Zoho Meeting Client
sequences.query: activity_type: "process-create" AND process_command_line: RGXi("ZohoMeeting") AND NOT process_name: RGXi("ZohoURS\.exe|ZohoURSService\.exe|ZA_Upgrader\.exe")
